title: Radiation exposure or solar event
reference: NASA Flight Rules: Solar Particle Event (SPE) Response & Acute Radiation Syndrome (ARS) Clinical Protocols.

q1.text: Is a Space Weather Alert active (Solar Particle Event / Coronal Mass Ejection) or is active dosimeter exceeding 1.0 mSv/hr?

i_shelter.text: ALL CREW EVACUATE TO STORM SHELTER: Relocate immediately to vehicle central storm shelter module surrounded by water tanks and food stowage. Seal radiation curtains.

q2.text: Does any crew member display acute prodromal symptoms: sudden nausea, vomiting, cutaneous erythema (skin flushing), or profound weakness?

i_meds.text: PRODROMAL RADIATION SYNDROME: Administer Ondansetron 8 mg oral/IV for emesis. Provide electrolyte hydration and record exact onset time of vomiting (critical prognostic indicator).

t_obs.text: Monitor vitals, fluid balance, and symptom evolution closely over the next 5 minutes in shelter.

q_symptom_prog.text: Did vomiting occur within 2 hours of exposure (indicating estimated whole-body absorbed dose > 2 Gy)?

i_high_dose.text: ACUTE HIGH-DOSE RADIATION PROTOCOL: Initiate IV fluid maintenance; collect peripheral blood droplet for emergency lymphocyte depletion kinetic assay; prepare Filgrastim (G-CSF) if available.

i_mild_rad.text: MODERATE RADIATION PRODOME: Maintain antiemetic therapy, enforce oral rehydration, and monitor lymphocyte counts every 12 hours.

t_shelter.text: Remain sheltered for 5-minute telemetry sync and await updated solar flux assessment from SWPC ground controllers.

q_spike.text: Has a single area dosimeter logged a transient anomaly while other sensors read nominal background (< 1.0 mSv/day)?

i_sensor_check.text: LOCALIZED / SENSOR ANOMALY: Inspect dosimeter battery, cross-reference with vehicle exterior radiation monitors, and log reading.

i_nominal_rad.text: RADIATION NOMINAL: Normal galactic cosmic ray background. Maintain routine daily dosimeter wear.

end_monitor.text: Radiation dose within acceptable operational boundaries. Log cumulative mission dose and maintain routine scheduled dosimetry checks.

end_escalate.text: HIGH RADIATION PROTOCOL ACTIVE: Remain sheltered until ground flight controllers clear event. Medical Officer prepared for Acute Radiation Syndrome medical countermeasures.
